notes: Years are inclusive. 'system' picks the upstream ability set each line gets at creation (worldofdarkness eraMortal/eraVampire/eraWerewolf/eraMage). Upstream has no Dark Ages or Renaissance set for Mage, so mages before 1837 use its Victorian set; that and the Great War mapping are WoDX choices, marked 'ourCall'.

profiles.name: Dark Ages
profiles.basis: V20 Dark Ages, Dark Ages: Werewolf, Mage: The Dark Ages, Dark Ages: Fae, Dark Ages: Inquisitor
profiles.switches: Roads; medieval abilities; Gauntlet chart 2 to 8; Pillars; no firearms; demons as spirits
ourCall: Mage uses upstream's Victorian ability set

profiles.name: Plague and Long Night
profiles.switches: Banality spike and the Shattering; Cappadocians fall in 1444
ourCall: Mage uses upstream's Victorian ability set

profiles.name: Renaissance
profiles.basis: V20 Dark Ages rules with period setting; The Sorcerers Crusade
profiles.switches: Spheres and the Order of Reason; Camarilla in 1486, Convention of Thorns in 1493, the Sabbat; early firearms
ourCall: Mage uses upstream's Victorian ability set

profiles.name: Victorian
profiles.basis: V20 with Victorian Age setting, W20, M20, C20, Wraith 20th
profiles.switches: Humanity plus Paths; gaslight cities; Ride stays

profiles.name: Wild West
profiles.basis: V20 The Wild West, W20 Wyld West Expansion Pack
profiles.switches: Railroads thicken the Gauntlet; Storm Umbra; revolvers and rifles

profiles.name: Great War
profiles.basis: Wraith: The Great War, plus each line's 20th book
profiles.switches: Storm-torn Shroud; trench, gas and artillery hazards
ourCall: Every line uses upstream's Victorian ability set, the closest it has to 1914

profiles.name: Modern
profiles.basis: Every 20th book; Hunter, Demon, Mummy, Kindred of the East, Orpheus in their basis editions
profiles.switches: Full modern abilities; Gauntlet chart 2 to 9; the 1999 switches

profiles.name: Future Darkness
profiles.basis: V20, World of Future Darkness, Cyberpunk 2020
profiles.switches: Masquerade erosion; cyberware and Humanity cost; the Net; Technica; the Fourth Corporate War
ourCall: The end year is open; 2099 is a placeholder

profiles.name: Classical (prologue)
profiles.switches: For prologues only: chosen with the era lock, never by date
ourCall: Werewolf uses the Dark Ages set and Mage the Victorian set; upstream has no Classical set for them

profiles.name: Living Gods (prologue)
profiles.switches: For prologues only: chosen with the era lock, never by date
ourCall: Werewolf uses the Dark Ages set and Mage the Victorian set; upstream has no Living Gods set for them
